name: gamma
label: Gamma
description: An AI-powered design partner that helps users generate presentations, documents, social media posts, cards, etc., via natural language.

generateGamma.label: Generate Gamma
generateGamma.description: Create a new Gamma generation job.

folderId.label: Folder
folderId.description: The folder to save the generated gamma into.

inputText.label: Input Text
inputText.description: Text used to generate your gamma (1-400,000 characters).

textMode.label: Text Mode
textMode.description: How you want your inputText to be modified.

format.label: Format
format.description: The type of artifact you want to create.

themeName.label: Theme Name
themeName.description: The theme from Gamma to be used. Defaults to workspace default.

numCards.label: Number of Cards
numCards.description: How many cards to create (default 10). Pro: 1-50, Ultra: 1-75.

cardSplit.label: Card Split
cardSplit.description: How your content will be divided into cards. Use '---' in text for breaks.

additionalInstructions.label: Additional Instructions
additionalInstructions.description: Extra specifications about the desired content and layouts (1-500 characters).

exportAs.label: Export As
exportAs.description: Additional file types for saving your gamma.

textOptions.label: Text Options
textOptions.description: JSON object for text attributes (e.g., amount, tone, audience, language).

imageOptions.label: Image Options
imageOptions.description: JSON object for image attributes (e.g., source, model, style).

cardOptions.label: Card Options
cardOptions.description: JSON object for card attributes (e.g., dimensions).

sharingOptions.label: Sharing Options
sharingOptions.description: JSON object for sharing attributes (e.g., workspaceAccess, externalAccess).

getGeneration.label: Get Generation
getGeneration.description: Given a Generation ID, fetch the status, outputs, metadata, etc.

generationId.label: Generation ID
generationId.description: The ID of the generation job (from the "Generate Gamma" action).
